findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax used in i18next message bundle for account-ui and admin-ui
findings.body: `error-invalid-multivalued-size` in `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties` (line 188) and `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties` (line 3138) was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. Unlike the FreeMarker themes under `themes/`, `account-ui` and `admin-ui` translate validation errors client-side using `i18next` (note that all other `error-*` keys in these two files use `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`). `i18next` does not support Java `MessageFormat` single-brace placeholders or `{2,choice,...}` subformats, so the raw `{0}`, `{1}`, and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` text will be rendered literally to users.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) TOTP message replaced with Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: In `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties` (line 112), `totpStep1` was updated using Traditional Chinese characters (`在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`) instead of Simplified Chinese (compare `login/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties` line 123: `在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`).
